notes.title: Version 3.0.0 updated
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36640960/264d1a9ebb3f8f1f2c41a9f98aef35680e40e5e1.png[/img]

[h3][FIXED][/h3][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where yoke was missing when opening another gallery with yoke selected.
[*]Some Japanese translations have been improved. Thank you to Tein for your help.
[*]A number of small bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

[h3][UPDATED][/h3][list]
[*]Steam streaming play test completed. You can play Last Evil using Steam Link application on mobile.
Instead, there are restrictions below on mobile.
- Can't control free camera in gallery.
- Unable to zoom in/out in battle.
[*]The achromatic texture of the Healer outfit has become brighter.
[*]Added defeat scene bariation for Patrols. As a result, the number of galleries increased by two.
[*]A new idle animation has been added to the succubus.
[*][b]Last Evil now support mod![/b] For more information, see the topic User Modding Support in a discussion.
[/list]

[h3][NOTICE][/h3][list]
[*][b]Steam cloud does not work in offline mode![/b]
This is the constraint that Steam cloud has.
Progress is saved in cloud only when running in online mode!
Before formatting or changing the computer, you must run it online once or copy the file separately.
[*]Scripting Backend has been changed from IL2CPP to Mono to support user mod.
Also, since many source codes have been modified, additional problems may arise.
Please inform me :)
[*][b]I decided that this update is the last major update of this game.[/b]
Because I think I've filled the volume of the game that I first thought.

Of course, I'll continue to do issue tracking after this.
Sometimes I might make a new mode.
But I'll spend most of my time developing a next game :)

Thank you!
[/list]

notes.title: Last Evil is now out of Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36640960/5087dfc623e0861de37355a10291bc2557319cba.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! it's us again! 

First of all we want to to thank all of you for sticking by this dev despite their rocky start. Thanks to you the dev was capable of accomplishing his goals in a relatively short time.

This isn't the end of the journey for this game though! You can still look forward to a few more updates and balance changes to make sure that this little gem continues to get polished to shine! Flame will be taking a well deserved break for the time being (don't worry if there are any serious issues he will sort them out.)

Again big thanks to all of you. We couldn't have reached to this point without your support and patience. You guys are just as much part of this project as we are. See you guys soon and have a great Summer Sale!

We have a great line up of games coming out this year! Look out for us at Critical Bliss to continue to provide you hentai games that are actually fun to play!

notes.title: I was shut down game service.
notes.notes:
I am very sorry to you.

In less than a week, I really received undeserved love from you. I've never had this much attention in my life (even a company-made game), and it's so exciting and happy that I updated it like it burns my soul.

I wanted to show you more content, and frankly I thought that could change my life.

But my greed was too much.
I can not explain in detail, but something terrible happened to me. I didn't know too much before EA release. (Ah, I want to emphasize. Steam is innocent. I love Steam and thanks so much for giving me this opportunity.)

And, players, Thank you very much for the attention.
And I'm delivering this ridiculous news, and I'm so miserable myself.

For all those who qualify, get a refund.

[*]It seems to me that I have handled almost all errors at the moment. There are some fatal bugs left, but these are not caused by errors, so it's hard for me to know what's going on.
If something goes wrong, always report it using the report or discussion board! It helps me keep track of bugs!
[*] Now I'm going to do some modeling and content work. I'm planning to update a bug fix every time I get a report.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[h3][Fixed][/h3][list]

[h3][Notice][/h3]
There are currently three bugs found.

The first is that the cards do not load properly in the hand during the battle. I haven't found the cause of the bug yet. But I modified the code at the expected point. If you encounter this bug, please start a new game.

Secondly, certain users are sometimes unable to jump to the battle screen. (On a black screen, all stats are displayed as 99) It looks like an algorithmic problem, but it's not easy to track bugs due to source optimization issues. I modified the client to track this problem. If you encounter this bug, please start a new game.

Third, the game will not run in the environment on some computers. After tracking, this seems to be a problem with Unity itself. I plan to do a Unity upgrade after the bug in the client has stabilized.

As the client changes, it can become more unstable. But now seems to be the time to gamble. I'm really sorry that I didn't say "I fixed the bug" for this patch.
